descriptionByLocale.en:
On behalf of the Canton of Bern, Diaconis’ labour integration offers various labour market measures for the sustainable professional integration of job seekers. One of them is the measure EAR (determination of labour market relevant resources), a location determination and potential assessment for German and French-speaking job seekers. It is aimed at people with an unclear reintegration strategy, if there is a need for clarification on labour market-relevant skills and an assessment of the integration potential for the labour market. The results form an important basis for further professional integration. The assigning authority is the cantonal office for unemployment insurance (RAV).
You combine psychological expertise with leadership experience and would like to build up a new labour market measure right from the start and shape it professionally? You know the professional integration and bring experience in case management, discussion and diagnostics? For the establishment and management of our new labour market measure EAR we are looking for 1. September 2026 or by arrangement for our location Ostermundigen a committed, professionally experienced and leadership-strong personality as

Head of Labour Market Measure (AMM) EAR 80 %

Your advantages with us

• Opportunity to build up a new labour market measure right from the start and shape it sustainably

• Varied activity with contact to different stakeholders

• Meaningful leadership task with social impact

• Collaboration in a committed and professional team

• Attractive and progressive employment conditions

• Internal and external training opportunities

• Modern workplace in Ostermundigen

• At least six weeks of vacation per year

Your tasks with us

• You lead the labour market measure EAR professionally and operationally and actively shape its development

• You ensure the successful implementation of the service contract as well as the cantonal specifications and quality requirements

• You lead, accompany and develop the professionals of the interdisciplinary team in their professional activities

• You ensure high professional quality in case management, resource clarification, documentation and reporting

• You are the contact person for the cantonal client and ensure a professional and reliable cooperation

• You are responsible for quality management as well as quality assurance and quality development of the AMM EAR

• You implement the given quality instruments and derive suitable development measures together with the client

• You create reports and proof of performance and ensure their timely submission

• You plan and accompany quality audits, evaluations and professional training of the team

• You actively contribute your technical and conceptual expertise in the further development of processes, quality standards and offers

Here's what you bring with you

• You have a Master’s degree (MSc or MA) in Psychology, preferably with a focus on Applied Psychology, Work and Organizational Psychology or a comparable psychological discipline

• You will have at least three years of proven professional experience in the field of professional integration after completing your Master's degree programme

• You have in-depth experience in conversation, case management, diagnostics and reporting

• You bring at least three years of proven leadership experience

• You have experience in quality management as well as quality assurance and quality development

• You have strong organizational and conceptual skills and are happy to take on responsibility

• You lead in an appreciative, solution-oriented manner and with a clear eye for quality and professional standards

• You enjoy accompanying and developing professionals and teams

• You have very good knowledge of German or French in word and writing. Knowledge of the other language is an advantage

• You have a very good written expression ability and are confident in using digital tools

Information can be provided by Mrs. Melanie Börner, Head of Labor Integration, Tel. 031 337 76 60, and Jannik Witmer, Foundation Director, Tel. 031 337 77 07.

Les résultats constituent une base importante pour la poursuite de l'intégration professionnelle. L'autorité compétente est le bureau cantonal de l'assurance chômage (RAV).

Vous connaissez l'intégration professionnelle et apportez de l'expérience dans la gestion de cas, la discussion et le diagnostic? Septembre 2026 ou par arrangement pour notre emplacement Ostermundige une personnalité engagée, professionnellement expérimentée et forte de leadership

• Vous assurez une haute qualité professionnelle dans la gestion des cas, la clarification des ressources, la documentation et les rapports
